description: Take an incoming WhatsApp message and turn it into (or attach it to) a lead — the intake path for Click-to-WhatsApp ads. Pass the raw webhook payload (or just the referral object) as `payload` and the sender's number; the ad reference is read from it. IMPORTANT: the referral only arrives with the FIRST message of a conversation, so it is recorded once and never overwritten by a later message that has none. Writing the same number twice does not create a second lead — the message joins the existing one. A message without an ad reference is still taken in, explicitly marked 'Herkunft unbekannt': someone wrote, that is the event; discarding it loses a real enquiry, and attributing it to whichever ad happens to run would be an invented number in the ad report.

campaign_id.description: Campaign to file the lead under.

from.description: The sender's phone number, any format.

message_id.description: WhatsApp message id (wamid.…) — the guard against double delivery.

name.description: Profile name, if WhatsApp supplied one.

payload.description: The raw webhook bundle, a single message, or the referral object. The ad reference is read from whichever it is.

name: ingest_whatsapp_lead
